sentences.text: The loan is a home loan term loan for an individual, with the purpose stated as purchase of a residential house for self-occupation and not for business, and it was sanctioned on 10 February 2026. [E3, E2]
For this case, RBI pre-payment charge treatment is marked not applicable, while the Directions also say prepayment charges are permitted only as per the stated conditions. [R7, R5]

Clause 9.3 levies a pre-payment charge of 3% of principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure, so that clause is not compliant with the applicable RBI pre-payment treatment for this loan. [E7, R7, R5]
